comment: Hand-authored subset of dump meshes to convert .uemodel -> .glb (M6 can regenerate this as asset-sources.generated.json). `src` is relative to the dump Characters/ folder (FINALS_DUMP env or the default in convert-meshes.py); `dst` is relative to public/models/. dst names match MODEL_BY_PIECE in import-catalog.ts. PBR maps (BaseColor/Normal/OcclusionCurvatureMaterialID/ColorMask) are auto-discovered from the mesh's sibling folder by suffix; override with an optional `textures: {baseColor,normal,occlusion,colorMask}` (dump-relative paths). Multi-material assets (e.g. heads) may instead set `materials: [{match, textures, alpha}]` to map textures per material by name-substring. `alpha`: 'mask' | 'blend' for masked/translucent pieces.

assets.comment: per-material: order matters (eyeshell before eyes, since 'eyes' is a prefix of 'eyeshell'). Eye/eyelash textures are shared under the Pioneer content root (../../Pioneer).

materials.comment: NO alpha: the D texture's alpha is a UE data mask (~0.8 over the face), not coverage — linking it makes the skin translucent (blotchy nose/eyes)
